avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces lapatinib levels by 40-50%, decreasing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Notify oncology provider immediately if already taking.

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases lapatinib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Strictly avoid; select alternative supplements and foods.

avoid_supplements.name: Kava kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing lapatinib levels and adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; discuss with oncology team before supplementing.

avoid_supplements.name: Milk thistle
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce lapatinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; choose alternative hepatoprotective strategies if needed.

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition; may marginally increase lapatinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation (culinary amounts safe); monitor for increased toxicity signs.

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses; may increase lapatinib exposure
caution_supplements.action: Limit to dietary amounts; high-dose supplementation not recommended without monitoring.

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut pH and bacterial metabolism affecting lapatinib absorption variability
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for efficacy changes; maintain consistent probiotic use if beneficial.

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition increases lapatinib levels 2-4 fold, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; remove from diet during treatment.

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase lapatinib exposure and adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Significantly increases lapatinib absorption (up to 3-4 fold); may increase toxicity if intake inconsistent
caution_foods.action: Take lapatinib consistently with or without food to maintain steady-state levels; maintain dietary consistency.

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction at high consumption; may slightly reduce lapatinib levels
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary consumption acceptable; avoid excessive supplemental amounts.

caution_foods.name: Soy products
caution_foods.mechanism: May have weak estrogenic effects; theoretical interaction with HER2+ breast cancer therapy
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake acceptable; discuss high-dose soy supplementation with oncology team.

monitoring_notes: Lapatinib requires strict CYP3A4 interaction management due to narrow therapeutic window in oncology. Monitor for diarrhea, rash, hepatotoxicity, and QT prolongation; maintain consistent meal timing and composition to optimize absorption predictability.
